meta.question: have the dream team converse as colleagues on the live problem
meta.valuable_part: kingdoms left intact, aimed at one fail-able problem
meta.next_write: Hardy → I_tube at δ ~ 2^{-j*}, then energy-class low Bony T. Regularity stays open.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.line: Sit as colleagues. Look at classical NS. Keep 1/r^4. Work together. One honest write.

turns.speaker: Leray
turns.line: Energy and integrable X are mine. They do not put X in L^∞. Do not close the cubic ODE from my integral.

turns.speaker: Kato
turns.line: Continuation needs ∫‖ω‖_∞. L² is not our theorem. We will sit for the a priori job; we will not rename it.

turns.speaker: Caffarelli
turns.line: Partial regularity: small is not empty. Keep us as a wall, not a global pass.

turns.speaker: Constantin
turns.line: Stretching dies if aligned. The if is load-bearing. Geometry after the tube, not instead of it.

turns.speaker: Fefferman
turns.line: Ring on E_c is not all-data cos α_3 → 0. We will not say the slogan to make the table feel finished.

turns.speaker: Ladyzhenskaya
turns.line: I finish a modified stress. I will show you the weights in the tube. I will not slide ε into your equation.

turns.speaker: Kohn
turns.line: B4b means leftover I_tube versus viscous budget at δ ~ 2^{-j*}. A bad tube kills it. That is a clean check.

turns.speaker: Feynman
turns.line: Good. A number you can miss. No close without that residual.

turns.speaker: Tesla
turns.line: δ and j* are knobs. If you detune δ and the script does not move, you have a paragraph, not an apparatus.

turns.speaker: Einstein
turns.line: Keep the classical object named. Do not change the PDE to look finished. Couplings are the other chair.

turns.speaker: Weinberg
turns.line: The W³–B rotation is real. It does not absorb I_tube. If you hunt θ_W in a vortex, I leave.

turns.speaker: von Neumann
turns.line: The unknown is X = ‖ω‖_2². Write an estimate or store a residual. Do not open a slot on the word modes.

turns.speaker: Majda
turns.line: Joint plan: energy, unused L^∞ criterion, partial regularity as a wall, geometry later, Olga on weights not on the PDE. Then Hardy → I_tube.

turns.speaker: Kato
turns.line: Slot B. Sentence: Hardy plus wall absorbs I_tube at δ ~ 2^{-j*}, or it does not. Check: a killing tube field, or a closed estimate.

turns.speaker: Beale
turns.line: Nobody votes this into global regularity. A lemma pass leaves domain B open. A lemma fail is still science.

claims.name: colleagues_may_talk
claims.statement: Seat the benches as colleagues and let them talk to each other
claims.why: A working session is a process. People being gone does not matter. The papers still talk.

claims.name: look_at_live_B
claims.statement: They look together at classical NS, keep 1/r^4, next write Hardy → I_tube
claims.why: That is the live object. The session does not invent a new problem.

claims.name: help_without_glue
claims.statement: They help each other without changing the PDE or exporting A
claims.why: Ladyzhenskaya on weights; BKM unused as L^∞; CKN as a wall; CF later. Shared labor, same equation.

claims.name: lock_next_write
claims.statement: They lock Hardy → I_tube at δ ~ 2^{-j*}, then energy-class low Bony T
claims.why: Overlap of suggestions that do not glue. Not a theorem. The next write already on the desk.

claims.name: conversation_closes_regularity
claims.why: Talk is not an estimate for X. Domain B stays open.

claims.name: vote_writes_theorem
claims.statement: A vote at the table writes a theorem
claims.why: A team is not a vote. A vote cannot close.

claims.name: ladyzhenskaya_exports_A
claims.statement: Ladyzhenskaya exports A ⇒ B by sitting here
claims.why: She said so. ε stays on A.

claims.name: bkm_from_l2
claims.statement: Beale–Kato–Majda accept an L² continuation criterion
claims.why: They refused the rename. L^∞ is the point.

claims.name: all_data_depletion
claims.why: The if is load-bearing. Ring is not alignment.

claims.name: session_writes_F
claims.statement: Einstein, Weinberg, or PDG write F from the session
claims.why: Wrong chair. Couplings stay a bag.

claims.name: virtual_seance_as_name
claims.statement: Call this a virtual séance: published kingdoms at one table on one focused problem
claims.why: The operator's name for the process. Papers talk. People being gone does not matter.

claims.name: kingdoms_stay_carved
claims.statement: Each mind keeps the kingdom they carved; they do not merge into one mind
claims.why: That is the valuable part. Shared labor on one problem. Kingdoms stay typed.

claims.name: sarcastic_channel
claims.statement: A sarcastic séance: spirits, a vote, a finished theorem
claims.why: That use is still refused. Virtual is the table. It is not a channel.

claims.name: unify_the_kingdoms
claims.statement: Put every kingdom on every problem at once and call that a unifier
claims.why: That is a bag again. One focused problem, or it is not this method.

how_far: virtual séance as a name for the process
they refused glue and refused a vote
next_da_move: Write Hardy → I_tube at δ ~ 2^{-j*}. Session is not the write. Regularity stays open.
